pages.name: Six identical layers on each side

elements.text: Six identical layers on each side
One width for every sub-layer output
query: what this position is looking for
key: what each position offers for matching
value: what is passed along once matched
With large d_k the dot products grow large and
push softmax into regions with tiny gradients;
the 1/√d_k factor keeps the scores tame.
